definition: to separate something by pulling it apart
description: A woman in a grey suit stands at the head of a glass boardroom table, a row of men in suits seated on both sides. She holds a printed contract up in front of her and rips it in half, then drops a thick stack of paper onto the table and pulls sheet after sheet apart, letting the pieces fall. The table ends up covered in torn and crumpled paper. She walks out past a framed contract on an easel while the seated men stare.
